title: Duplicate-coordinate inner product formula
statement: Let $F$ be a Gowers family of order $k+1$, choose a coordinate $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(k+1)$, and choose $b\in\mathbb F_2$. The Gowers inner product of the family obtained by replacing coordinate $i$ by $b$ equals the average over $y:\mathrm{Fin}(k)\to\mathbb F_2^n$ of the square of the corresponding half expectation: $\operatorname{Inner}(\operatorname{duplicate}_{i,b}F)=\mathbb E_y\bigl[\operatorname{HalfExpectation}_{i,b}(F;y)^2\bigr]$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a Gowers family of order $k+1$
